primitives.name: Data Collection Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: I HAD to collect all my data for myself, as nothing existed, so far as I know, that would satisfy even my primary requircment.
primitives.assumptions: No pre-existing dataset meets primary requirements; data must be independently gathered.

primitives.assumptions: Two generations required for heritability estimation; population size ensures statistical validity.

primitives.name: Environmental Consistency Condition
primitives.verbatim_quote: They must havc lived under conditions that were of a usual kind, and in which no great varieties of nurture were to be found.
primitives.assumptions: Controlled environment minimizes confounding variables affecting trait expression.
